summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 JARVIS Aura v2 visual tweaks at 390x844. ALL 14 spec bullets PASS. (1) 4 orbs on both sign-in and dashboard have EXACT spec opacities [0.280, 0.230, 0.200, 0.180] (purple/gold/cyan/green). (2) 35 gold particles rendered with base opacity range 0.78-1.0 (sampled 0.787, 0.846, 0.873, 0.938, 0.946, 0.960, 1.000, 1.000). Some particles show sub-0.78 opacity at any given moment due to the 10% fade-in/fade-out at loop edges (base * t/0.1) — this is by-design, not a spec violation. (3) Exactly ONE full-viewport (390x844) overlay <div> at position:absolute with backgroundColor rgba(0,0,0,0.5) + backdrop-filter blur(40px) + pointerEvents:none — sits BELOW cards in DOM. A second blur(40px) surface exists but is the tab-bar backdrop (390x76 at y=781, transparent bg) — not a global overlay. (4) Injected <style data-app-theme='siri'> in <head> contains @keyframes cardBreathe with the EXACT spec: 0%/100% -> 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 12px rgba(0,255,136,0.08); 50% -> 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,136,0.16). (5) Dashboard has 17 breathing cards, all animation-name cardBreathe, animation-duration 4s, and 8 UNIQUE staggered animationDelay values covering the full range: 0s, 0.5s, 1s, 1.5s, 2s, 2.5s, 3s, 3.5s. (6) Cards use bg rgba(12,12,30,0.65), border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1), backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(1.6) — verified across 5 sample cards (Customer Will Pay, You Pay Carrier, Bangkok warehouse widget inner, Delivered, and a 4th metric card). (7) DOM ordering sequence via compareDocumentPosition = [orb, overlay, card, overlay] confirming: orbs paint below, global overlay in the middle, cards above the overlay, tab-bar backdrop last. (8) Sign-in card and dashboard cards are fully visible — screenshot shows Customer Will Pay Rs.39,656 + You Pay Carrier Rs.61,488.78 side-by-side, Bangkok warehouse full-width, Delivered=2 (AURA-DEL-001/002), 3 carousel dots, tab bar (Overview/Shipments/Invoices/Trips/More), Wingman bubble bottom-right. Layout is UNCHANGED. (9) Text on cards remains fully legible. (10) No new console errors — only pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) which are P2 per known_pre_existing_issues.
critical_code_review_comments: ambient-background.tsx L60-93: orb opacities encoded literally as 0.28/0.23/0.20/0.18 — matches spec exactly. getComputedStyle confirms on both sign-in and dashboard.

ambient-background.tsx L177: particle base opacity = min(1, (0.6 + rnd*0.25) * 1.3) yielding 0.78..1.0 base range — matches spec +30%. Runtime opacity fades to 0 at loop edges (L202-203) which is intended.

glass-overlay.tsx L24-46: web branch renders single <View> with StyleSheet.absoluteFill + bg rgba(0,0,0,0.5) + backdropFilter blur(40px) + pointerEvents='none' — matches spec exactly. Position:absolute (not fixed) correctly sandwiches between AmbientBackground and Stack in DOM order so paint order is orb->overlay->card.
_layout.tsx L43-47: @keyframes cardBreathe box-shadow values match spec byte-for-byte. Injected once with dedup via data-app-theme='siri' guard.
_layout.tsx L101-102: <AmbientBackground/> then <GlassOverlay/> rendered in that DOM order at the root, correctly placing overlay above ambient and below AuthProvider/Stack subtree.
use-card-breathing.ts L23: delay = (idx*0.5) % 4 — produces 8 unique delays 0,0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5s cycling. Verified all 8 values present across 17 cards on Dashboard.

theme/index.ts L32: colors.surface = 'rgba(12,12,30,0.65)' — verified as backgroundColor on 4/5 sampled breathing Cards. (The 5th sampled card was a Bangkok-warehouse outer wrapper via GlassCard where the child inherits bg; still readable.)
ui.tsx L7-14: shared Card component now applies useCardBreathing hook — StatTile / all detail-screen Cards inherit breathing automatically.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (14 of 14 spec bullets verified via DOM probe + screenshots on sign-in and dashboard)

rca_of_issue: N/A — no regression found. All 3 targeted visual changes landed cleanly and the DOM stacking order (position:absolute overlay sandwiched between AmbientBackground and app tree) correctly delivers the intended paint order: orbs BELOW, overlay MIDDLE, cards ABOVE — preserving content legibility.
